## 7. Governs edges (kept controls only)
`C7-governs.tsv` is the machine-readable version of this table. Each owner endpoint is an exact accepted owner TSV record. Edge kinds say what changes, not merely “overlaps.” Settings kinds mean changed eligibility, calculations or presentation; data/action kinds mean changed resulting numbers or state. `_label_only` explicitly marks never-open or C6-skipped mechanics. Commissioner authority is a role/access effect, not permission for an owner to grant it. No retired/merged/deferred control is smuggled into this kept-only registry.

These are evidence-backed dependency edges, **not tests of MFL enforcement**. General League Setup’s capacities feed owner roster/add/drop/IR/taxi/lineup behavior; detailed validation is governed by the more specific kept controls too. Disabled enforcement flags remain rules that could change behavior if reconfigured. C6 League Awards is kept but its edge is only menu-label → existing owner awards display; no award-setting field was inspected.
